title: The future of AI video isn't prompt engineering. It's scene engineering.
description:
Instead of wasting credits on endless prompt iterations, you can now build your video visually—placing characters, defining camera angles, arranging scenes, and letting AI handle the prompting for you. The result is faster workflows, better consistency, and more cinematic outputs.

The best creators don't generate more videos.

They build better systems.
